name: Batoprazine
summary: Batoprazine is a drug of the phenylpiperazine class which has been described as a serenic or antiaggressive agent. It acts as a 5-HT1A and 5-HT1B receptor agonist. It is closely related to eltoprazine, fluprazine, and naphthylpiperazine, of which possess similar actions and effects.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a 5-HT1A and 5-HT1B receptor agonist.

uses.en: It was studied as a drug to reduce aggression, in animals and as a possible human medicine, but was never marketed.
uses.zh: 它曾被研究作為減少攻擊性的藥物，用於動物並作為可能的人用藥物，但從未上市。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被研究作为减少攻击性的药物，用于动物并作为可能的人用药物，但从未上市。

fact.en: It was described as a serenic, a word coined for drugs meant to reduce aggression without sedating. It is closely related to eltoprazine and fluprazine from the same research programme.
fact.zh: 它曾被形容為 serenic，這是為「能減少攻擊性而不造成鎮靜」的藥物所創的詞。它與同一研究計畫中的 eltoprazine 與 fluprazine 關係密切。
fact.zhHans: 它曾被形容为 serenic，这是为「能减少攻击性而不造成镇静」的药物所创的词。它与同一研究计划中的 eltoprazine 与 fluprazine 关系密切。
